card.name: Dental and oral setting before next word
card.fires_on: Small words or marks (an, the, an open bracket, a comma) and word endings that come right after teeth, mouth or oral-infection wording, where a mouth-related noun may come next.

modes.label: Linking word after teeth
modes.description: A small word such as an or the right after a phrase about teeth or a quadrant of the mouth.
modes.example: satisfactory anesthesia achieved with this amount of drug will allow treatment of the teeth in an<< entire>> quadrant.

modes.label: Oral infection terms
modes.description: The end of Bacteroides or a bracket after Fusospirochetosis, in lists of infections of the mouth and throat.

modes.label: Tooth eruption
modes.description: The word the in a sentence about which teeth come in last.
modes.example: The last teeth to erupt in the adult set are<< the>> molars.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like period, gum, gums and mouth, and away from words like composite and silver.
card.plain: It fires on small words in dental or mouth-infection text, where a mouth-related word like gum or period may come next.
